frozen_before: any paired number exists. No multi-seed run has been executed at the time this file is written; the sweep kernel is not yet built. This is the pre-registration, not a post-hoc reading.
supersedes_nothing: This does NOT replace wiki/glm_generator_finetune_acceptance_bar.json. That bar froze the question 'does the fine-tuned model fall below the 3-mer Markov null at 0.6679'. It was answered: NO (0.8058). This bar freezes a DIFFERENT question about the NOISE of the delta that answer rests on.
question: The carried reading is that LoRA fine-tuning made distinguishability WORSE by +0.0271 (zero-shot 0.7787 -> fine-tuned 0.8058, mode-both, lower is better). Both numbers are a SINGLE generation draw at one seed. Is that delta larger than its own sampling variation, and does distinguishability rise monotonically across fine-tuning epochs?
why_the_existing_control_does_not_answer: falsifier.self_control_ceiling splits the NATURAL corpus against itself across discriminator seeds. It is identical in both committed arms (mode-both 0.5865, kmer 0.5447) because it depends only on the natural corpus and those seeds, not on either generated set. It bounds 'is this distinguishable from natural at all' -- both arms far exceed it -- and is silent on whether two generated sets from two weight sets differ by more than sampling noise.

decision_quantity.definition: delta_s = score_ft_ep3(s) - score_zs(s), computed PER SEED s, mode-both
decision_quantity.why_paired: Var(A - B) = Var(A) + Var(B) - 2Cov(A, B). One arm's seed spread is NOT the uncertainty of A - B. Scoring both models at the SAME seed also cancels the shared terms -- within a seed the eval windows, the discriminator split and the natural corpus are identical -- so a paired delta isolates the weights.
decision_quantity.anti_pattern_this_avoids: Deriving the band from one arm's seed spread. That is the documented error in feedback_tolerance_band_from_the_tested_quantity, whose FIRST recorded instance (2026-10-20) was this same generator and the same shape. The v1 draft of this plan did exactly that and was corrected on review before any run.

no_numeric_band_is_frozen_here: Deliberate. The magnitude of the sampling variation is precisely what this run measures, so freezing a numeric threshold now would be guessing at the scale -- the documented way a bar gets mis-specified. The rules below compare the delta to its OWN measured variation and are therefore scale-free.
seed_set_rationale: Ten seeds, extending falsifier.self_control_ceiling's own seeds=(0,1,2,3,4) convention. MUST contain 7, because 7 is the falsifier CLI default and therefore the seed both committed arms ran at, which is what makes the anchors checkable. Cost at ten seeds is 4 models x 10 seeds = 40 scorings; at the measured 138 s per scoring plus 578 s training that is about 1.7 hours, well inside one Kaggle session.

DELTA_ROBUST.condition: every seed's delta_s has the same sign as the committed +0.0271 AND the mean of delta_s exceeds the spread of delta_s
DELTA_ROBUST.reading: The carried reading survives. Fine-tuning does make distinguishability worse, and the delta is larger than its generation-sampling variation. The measured variation must from then on be quoted beside the delta.

DELTA_NOT_ESTABLISHED.condition: the signs of delta_s are mixed, OR the mean of delta_s is within the spread of delta_s
DELTA_NOT_ESTABLISHED.reading: A CORRECTION to a carried claim. 'Fine-tuning made it worse' is NOT established at one draw per arm. This does NOT establish the opposite -- it says the sign of the effect is not resolved by this instrument at this geometry.
DELTA_NOT_ESTABLISHED.propagation_note: Do NOT edit the two committed arm artifacts. Their measured numbers stand; what changes is what may be CONCLUDED from their difference. Any correction elsewhere is a user decision.

INSTRUMENT_INVALID.condition: the Markov null does not reproduce 0.6679 (mode-both) / 0.5990 (kmer), OR the self-control does not reproduce 0.5865 / 0.5447, OR any model-by-seed cell is missing from the grid
INSTRUMENT_INVALID.reading: No delta or trajectory claim is made. A missing cell is not averaged over.

trajectory_outcomes.scored_on: paired per-seed differences between consecutive epoch checkpoints, same seed set

OVERFIT_MONOTONE.condition: each consecutive epoch step is up, and sign-consistent across seeds
OVERFIT_MONOTONE.reading: Gentler adaptation is the lever -- fewer epochs, lower learning rate, or early stopping.

FLAT_NOT_EPOCHS.condition: no consecutive epoch difference is sign-consistent across seeds
FLAT_NOT_EPOCHS.reading: Epoch count is not the cause. The adaptation DIRECTION itself is wrong, which is a different and larger problem than over-training.

HELPS_THEN_DEGRADES.condition: epoch 1 is below zero-shot sign-consistently across seeds, and a later epoch is above it
HELPS_THEN_DEGRADES.reading: Early stopping is the lever, and the method has a usable regime that 3 epochs overshoots.

TRAJECTORY_UNRESOLVED.condition: no consecutive difference is sign-consistent AND the spread of delta_s exceeds the total epoch-1-to-epoch-3 range
TRAJECTORY_UNRESOLVED.reading: The trajectory is smaller than the instrument's noise at this geometry. The remedy is more draws or a larger n, NOT a conclusion.

anchor_rule.ANCHOR_DRIFT: If the seed-7 zero-shot score differs from the committed 0.7787, or the seed-7 epoch-3 score from the committed 0.8058, by more than the spread of delta_s, the run is labelled ANCHOR_DRIFT and NO mechanism claim is made. Rationale: RECORDED warns that CUDA yields different sampled sequences than CPU for this generator; this run is T4-to-T4 against T4 numbers, but cuDNN nondeterminism at a fixed seed is not excluded, so the anchors are checked against the measured spread rather than for exact equality.

not_the_frozen_arm: Epochs 1 and 2 are NOT the pre-registered method: wiki/glm_generator_finetune_acceptance_bar.json freezes method_frozen.epochs = 3. The bar 0.6679 is NOT restated here as clearable by an epoch-1 or epoch-2 checkpoint, and no outcome in this file may be reported as the frozen arm's result. Epoch 3 IS the frozen method and is the only checkpoint comparable to the committed arm B.
what_this_design_does_NOT_bound: TRAINING variance. All four scored models come from ONE training trajectory; the seed set varies GENERATION only. So a DELTA_ROBUST verdict establishes that the delta survives generation noise and says nothing about run-to-run training noise. A second training run at a different torch seed is the test for that and is deliberately out of scope.

forecast.reasoning: For: +0.0271 is a fifth of the distance from the self-control ceiling (0.5865) to the observed scores (~0.79), and the kmer mode moved in the SAME direction (+0.0204), which two independent feature sets agreeing on a sign makes less likely to be pure noise. Against: n=120 generated sequences is small, a held-out AUROC on 120-vs-1200 has substantial sampling variation, and nobody has ever measured it for this instrument -- the honest prior on an unmeasured noise floor spanning a 0.027 gap is close to a coin flip. Recorded so no result can be retro-fitted.
forecast.trajectory_reasoning: Conditional on DELTA_ROBUST the trajectory is likely readable, since a resolvable endpoint difference implies the intermediate steps are probably resolvable too. If the delta is not established the trajectory is very likely TRAJECTORY_UNRESOLVED, which is why the two verdicts are reported separately rather than combined.

honest_limits: One organism (E. coli K-12), one corpus, one training trajectory.
An upstream window is a PROXY for a promoter, not a mapped transcription start site.

A k-mer discriminator measures LOCAL composition; the published audits that separate generated from natural sequence name LONG-RANGE organisation as the failure, which k-mer features cannot see. So a low distinguishability remains necessary, NOT sufficient.
Seeds vary generation only; training variance is unmeasured by construction.
n=120 is the committed geometry and is kept for comparability with the anchors, not because it is the best choice for variance.
